regions.merged_text: Rev. Father Superior who has been in with a severe cold for about two weeks wished me to convey our sympathy to the Sisters on account of the unreasonable and unjust eviction which the "killing letter of the law" has enabled unscrupulou men to score against them. - an eviction which we are confi- dent the great majority of our separated brethern will con- demn as done in their name and will regret. Needless to say we all hoped that things would never come to such a farce a- gainst common justice and charity. However, the victories of the world are short-lived- "man proposes but God disposes." We may be sure that Almighty God has not permitted things to take such a course without some good design of His own - to turn evil into good. At all events the words of our Divine Master, "Blessed are ye when they shall revile you and per- secute you ... unjustly for my sake .... ", should be a consola- tion to you and an encouragement. The sisters will hardly be able to do anything better than to pray earnestly for their persecutors, according to the same divine authority. "Do good to them that hate you, and pray for them that per- secute and calumniate you. Praying Almighty God to direct you and them - and us all according to His merciful will and inclosing a little donation from Rev. Father Superior to help you in your present need, I remain
